title: Edit Distance
statement: Return the minimum number of single-character insertions, deletions or replacements needed to turn word1 into word2.
hints: Another two-dimensional table: best[i][j] is the cost of converting the first i characters into the first j.
Seed the edges: converting a prefix into the empty string costs one deletion per character, and vice versa.
On a character match, carry best[i-1][j-1] across for free. Otherwise take 1 + the minimum of the three neighbours, which correspond to replace, delete and insert.
